title: Morphisms of couples give morphisms of spectral sequences
statement: Let $(D,E,\alpha,f,g)$ and $(D',E',\alpha',f',g')$ be exact couples [def-sp-exact-couple] in the same abelian category. A morphism of exact couples is a pair of maps $t_D:D\to D'$ and $t_E:E\to E'$ preserving bidegrees and satisfying $t_D\alpha=\alpha't_D$, $t_Df=f't_E$, and $t_Eg=g't_D$. Such a morphism induces, for every $r$, a morphism $E_r\to E'_r$ of the spectral sequences, compatible with the differentials. If both couples satisfy the hypotheses of [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence], then for every total degree $n$ the map $t_D:D^{0,n}\to D'^{0,n}$ of their canonical abutments respects the filtrations [def-sp-filtration] constructed there, and the induced map $\operatorname{gr}^pA^n\to\operatorname{gr}^pA'^n$ on the associated graded pieces is, under the identifications $E_\infty^{p,n-p}\cong\operatorname{gr}^pA^n$ of [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence], the map $E_\infty\to E'_\infty$ [def-sp-convergence] induced by $t_E$.

proof.text: Package the given maps and squares as a CoupleMorphism, transporting the type-zero g target to its initialG target by eqToHom naturality. Apply derivedCoupleFunctoriality to obtain compatible page maps, differential commutation and the kernel/projection squares, as well as the limiting cycle restriction and quotient maps for any limiting subobjects.

Apply halfPlaneConvergence separately to X and Y, retaining its normalized colimits, limiting subobjects and canonical graded comparisons. Commutation with alpha gives commutation with alphaDiagonal by eqToHom naturality. The maps tD followed by the target cocone form a cocone on the source diagonal; the universal property of AlphaColimit produces f with every cocone square. The normalization at first index zero makes that cocone map an isomorphism, so cancellation in the index-zero square identifies f with tD at (0,n) after the specified object transports. Apply Mathlib imageSubobjectMap to each cocone square to supply the restrictions witnessing filtration preservation.

Choose the limiting cycle restriction z and quotient map tInf from derivedCoupleFunctoriality. The factorization of initialG through the limiting cycles commutes with z: cancel the monic target cycle inclusion and use the initialG square. Postcompose with the boundary cokernel projection and use its quotient square to show toPageInfinity is natural in tD. Choose the canonical isomorphisms e and e-prime directly from halfPlaneConvergence, which already states their squares with toPageInfinity and toGradedPiece. Define gr as e inverse followed by tInf and e-prime. The two canonical comparison squares, the naturality of toPageInfinity and the inverse identities prove the toGradedPiece square and the final graded compatibility square. No separate half-plane graded canonical theorem is needed.
